name: Ergo
description: A highly customisable Task Management app that helps you plan your day.
notes: The snippet: a small window with the task running now, its timer, the day and Spotify
Open it from Snippet in the sidebar, the tray menu, or Ctrl+Shift+S; it stays on top and out of the taskbar
Tick, time or add a task in either window and the other shows it within a second
